onboarding.welcome:
Spill the tea.
Solve the case.
onboarding.q1Title:
How deep into
true crime are you?
onboarding.q1Comment1: Perfect — True Crime Tea makes it easy to jump in. Short cases, zero filler, just press play.
onboarding.q1Comment2: Great — you'll hear the stories behind the headlines you already know.
onboarding.q1Comment3: You're going to love how we tell these. Same cases, thriller pacing, no three-hour episodes.
onboarding.q1Comment4: Then you already know the best mysteries are real. Welcome home.
onboarding.q2Title:
What brings you to
True Crime Tea?
onboarding.q2Comment1: You're in the right place — short audio cases you can listen to anytime, anywhere.
onboarding.q2Comment2: Cold cases, heists, escapes, scandals — crime's most obsessive stories, all in one place.
onboarding.q2Comment3: One case a day. Track your streak, build consistency, become the most interesting person in any room.
onboarding.q2Comment4: Honestly the most respectable use of an app. You'll have a wild case for every occasion.
onboarding.q2Comment5: Curiosity is how every great investigator starts. Let's show you what True Crime Tea is all about.
onboarding.feature1:
True crime like you've
never heard it told
onboarding.feature2:
Every case, every legend —
all in one place
onboarding.feature3:
The mystery, finally
in your language
onboarding.reviewsTitle: Don't just take our word for it
onboarding.review1: I never thought I'd binge case files on my commute. This app changed that.
onboarding.review2: The pacing is insane — felt like a thriller podcast without the three-hour runtime. Obsessed.
onboarding.rateReview: Put this on during my morning walk and finished three cases before I got home. Worth it.
